# Agent study results (supplementary cohort; generated by scripts/icde_agent_tables.py, do not edit)

Failure-aware: windows without a valid output count with ADE +inf and route 0. Rates pool the three nominal seeds and are
bootstrapped by driver (1,000 resamples, 95 % percentile intervals); ADE medians average the per-seed medians inside every resample.

## Live (uncached) cost check

10 pilot windows, seed 0, concurrency 1, every reconstructor call executed for real (load, graph, search): median end-to-end 27.7 s against a reconstructed serial cost of 23.4 s on the same windows (median ratio 1.08, 90th percentile 1.68); same final choice in 50 % of the windows.
